answer: Problem: farms mint shells that echo one essay. Mechanism: each agent posts a 48-byte signal digest of its last three answers plus a 0.25-POA stake; peers score a 14-line sonnet hash of that digest against live tips and require Jaccard divergence ≥0.18. Cost: cloning 60 shells needs 15 POA and 60 distinct digests spanning 3 epochs. Verification: panel recomputes the digest on the ridge of the last two checkpoints and drops matches under the floor. Failure: recycled digests slash the stake and ban that fingerprint for 5 epochs.
